text:
```yaml
name: Security Scan
on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Run security scanner
        id: scanner
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          python scripts/scan_plugin.py
          echo "SCANNER_EXIT_CODE=$?" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Fail on BLOCK findings
        if: env.SCANNER_EXIT_CODE == '1'
        run: |
          echo "BLOCK findings detected. Failing job."
          exit 1

      - name: Warn on WARN findings
        if: env.SCANNER_EXIT_CODE == '2'
        run: |
          echo "WARN findings detected. Please review."
```
